title: Agents work with secrets through a piped-stdin CLI, never through transcript-visible values
iWant: the CLI to keep secret values off the surfaces an agent workflow creates
soThat: agent transcripts, tool logs, and workspace backups are safe to keep and share

acceptanceCriteria.description: A verb that produces a secret value writes it only to stdout as raw bytes intended for a piped consumer; running it with stdout on a terminal without `--show` refuses and prints an explanatory message that does not contain the value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a shell invocation `secrets read N` where stdout is a TTY and no `--show` flag is passed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is non-zero, stderr names `SECRETS_TTY_WITHOUT_SHOW`, and stdout contains no bytes of the secret value for `N`

acceptanceCriteria.description: A verb that accepts a secret value reads it from stdin only; passing it as a command-line argument is refused with a stable code.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a shell invocation `secrets put N V` where `V` is a positional argument
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is non-zero, stderr names `SECRETS_VALUE_ON_ARGV_REFUSED`, and no vendor write is issued

acceptanceCriteria.description: The CLI's structured output surface (`--json`, `--report`) never carries secret values; only names and metadata are emitted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator running `secrets list --json` in an environment where every declared secret resolves
acceptanceCriteria.then: every top-level entry carries `name`, `environment`, `owner`, `rotationDays`, `lastRotatedAt`, and `required`; no entry contains a field whose value equals or byte-includes any resolved secret value

acceptanceCriteria.description: The CLI's own log stream (verbose, debug) refuses to emit a secret value even when a bug elsewhere hands it one; a value passed to the logger is redacted to a fixed-length placeholder before any bytes leave the process.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a test that instruments the CLI logger with a captured value V that would have been mistakenly logged
acceptanceCriteria.when: the CLI runs and the log capture is read back
acceptanceCriteria.then: no captured log line contains V or any substring of length greater than the placeholder length, and every line in place carries the fixed placeholder token
